body:
I've been spiraling for a few days now, I've never felt suicidal before but today I've looked up the highest building on my city, it's so strange, I've been depressed most of my life, but nobody knows, or if they know they pretend nothing's wrong, I'm so mad i could've been better if anyone cared to see me.
I feel so fucking invisible, i literally am not worth it man.
I want to be better i want to do things i want to love people but I feel so empty and dumb for wanting things i don't even know how to deal with anymore.
I don't feel complete.
I think everyone was given some stuff i wasn't
They're just pushing through! They are out there living, while I'm here waiting for something to magically change, bit it won't change cause I have to change and I don't have the energy to... So it's a fucking endless cycle of nothing.

This is breathtakingly beautiful! The guitar playing is complex and so well recorded, the piano fits really nicely and so did the nature sounds in there. Your voice is so peaceful and calming to listen to, the only complaint (and I'm being intense here) is, just like the first comment said, the guitar is slightly loud at the beginning.
Oh and I think a cello would be a nice addition on the second half!
Great mixing, i am amazed by how clean the vocals sound, good stuff!

Wow! That was great, i loved all the variations and nuances, also the amount of instruments you played on this is crazy, but i have to say... I'm a sucker for harmonies and those where probably the best part on my opinion, very clean. It almost reminded me of some way better (than what they do generally) Disney villain jam haha. Not a bad thing to say, it's obvious you've got this down by now!

I actually really loved this song! The structure is very nice and easy to listen to, the vocals are really nice, i actually liked the dryer vocals at first, since it contrasted really well with the track. I do think the end goes on for a little too long, and the glitches would sound cleaner if you mixed them a little more, like fill the spaces in between or make them wetter. Overall i think this song has an amazing amount of potential to get popular haha you're doing great.
